# FEDS Skills (KSoR Rung 1)

- [angular-template-syntax](knowledge/angular-template-syntax/index.md): Use for Angular bindings, directives, control flow, forms, and templates. Triggers on 'Angular template', '*ngIf', 'directive', 'signal', 'two-way binding'. Do NOT use as a replacement for TypeScript component architecture, business logic, or general DOM APIs.
- [complete-frontend-developer-guide](knowledge/complete-frontend-developer-guide/index.md): Use for broad frontend architecture, browser behavior, HTTP, HTML/CSS/JS semantics, TypeScript, frameworks, data fetching, forms, testing, accessibility, performance, SEO, security, compatibility, i18n, and production gotchas. Triggers on 'frontend guide', 'how web works', 'complete frontend guide', 'frontend architecture and gotchas', 'frontend best practices', 'browser rendering'. Do NOT use for generic documentation search, one-file fixes covered by narrower skills, backend service design, database administration, or unscoped internet research.
- [complete-frontend-developer-reference](knowledge/complete-frontend-developer-reference/index.md): Use for broad frontend architecture, web fundamentals, HTTP and DNS, browser rendering and event loop, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, browser APIs, frameworks, tooling, testing, accessibility, performance, SEO, security, compatibility, i18n, design, deployment, and production gotchas. Triggers on 'frontend guide', 'how the web works', 'complete frontend guide', 'frontend architecture', 'HTML CSS JavaScript deep dive', 'browser rendering', 'frontend glossary', 'frontend learning roadmap'. Do NOT use for one-file fixes covered by narrower language or framework skills, backend-only implementation, database administration, exact browser-support claims without verification, or unscoped internet research.
- [css](knowledge/css/index.md): Use for CSS layout, responsive design, tokens, animation, and visual accessibility. Triggers on 'CSS', 'Flexbox', 'Grid', 'media query', 'custom properties', 'animations'. Do NOT use as the primary skill for markup structure, application behavior, TypeScript, or generated utility classes without reviewing output.
- [csv](knowledge/csv/index.md): Use for CSV parsing, quoting, delimiters, encoding, and tabular cleanup. Triggers on 'CSV', 'comma-separated values', 'tabular import', 'CSV quoting', 'CSV transform'. Do NOT use when a typed schema or API format should be used for transport or code generation.
- [ejs](knowledge/ejs/index.md): Use for EJS server-side HTML templates, includes, escaping, and caching. Triggers on 'EJS', 'embedded JavaScript template', 'scriptlet tags', 'server rendering'. Do NOT use for client rendering, modern component architecture, or privileged security-sensitive templating.
- [escalate-review](knowledge/escalate-review/index.md): Prepare a frontend engineering escalation package for a human reviewer or another engineer to act on. Use when ANY of these is true: a QA or review process blocked the work ("QA blocked this", "review blocked it", "QA sign-off refused"); the user is visibly frustrated or sends negative sentiment; there is an accessibility, WCAG, or legal-adjacent risk; the user asks to hand it off, hand this off, hand it over, or get a second opinion, or send it for human review; or a high-impact issue is still unresolved. Triggers on "hand this off", "hand it off", "hand this over", "another engineer", "get a second opinion", "send for review", "QC blocked this", "QA blocked this", "escalate this". Do NOT use for routine drafting, for a written note or summary about a task (that is summarize-component), for generic documentation lookup, or for creating a component.
- [find-similar-components](knowledge/find-similar-components/index.md): Use when the user asks whether prior frontend work exists, needs a similar task, past component, saved layout pattern, or warns against duplicate effort. Triggers on "have we done this before?", "find similar components", "find related frontend work", or "what did we build before?". It searches the saved frontend workspace before new drafting. Do NOT use for generic framework documentation lookup when no saved workspace question exists.
- [frontend-development](knowledge/frontend-development/index.md): Use for frontend website development, responsive implementation, component creation, CSS styling, JavaScript functionality, or React/Vue/Angular work. Triggers on 'build UI', 'responsive page', 'web interface', 'component', 'JavaScript functionality', 'React' or 'Vue'. Do NOT use for broad backend, database migrations, schema changes, deployment approval, or non-UI application logic.
- [frontend-workspace](knowledge/frontend-workspace/index.md): Use to safely save, search, list, review, publish, or compare frontend tasks and components with WCAG notes, layouts, and implementation patterns through the scoped MCP server. Triggers on 'remember this component', 'find a similar component', 'what did we build before', 'list my frontend tasks', 'review this component', 'store frontend implementation details', 'publish this approved component'. Do NOT use for runtime database migrations, broad SQL, ad-hoc schema changes, unbounded database browsing, or approving your own publication.
- [graphql](knowledge/graphql/index.md): Use for GraphQL operations, schema fields, variables, and pagination. Triggers on 'GraphQL', 'query', 'mutation', 'fragment', 'SDL', 'schema', 'resolver'. Do NOT use as a general REST API design, backend service invention, or unchecked broad-data fetching skill.
- [handlebars](knowledge/handlebars/index.md): Use for Handlebars helpers, partials, and HTML template generation. Triggers on 'Handlebars', 'HBS', 'helper', 'partial', 'compile', 'template'. Do NOT use for application state, framework components, business calculations, or modern JSX render trees.
- [html](knowledge/html/index.md): Use for HTML markup structure, forms, media, metadata, and accessibility. Triggers on 'HTML', 'markup', 'page structure', 'form fields', 'meta tags', 'semantic elements'. Do NOT use as the primary skill for CSS-only styling, JavaScript behavior, framework component logic, broad SQL, or deployment configuration.
- [javascript](knowledge/javascript/index.md): Use for browser behavior, events, DOM logic, fetching data, modular UI code, and progressive enhancement. Triggers on 'JavaScript', 'JS', 'event handler', 'DOM', 'fetch', 'promise', 'module'. Do NOT use as the primary skill for markup semantics, visual CSS styling, compile-time type contracts, or backend persistence.
- [json](knowledge/json/index.md): Use for JSON schemas, payloads, configuration, serialization, and validation. Triggers on 'JSON', 'payload', 'schema', 'config file', 'response body', 'serialization'. Do NOT use for JSON5-only features, YAML/TOML config, GraphQL operations, Protobuf schema, or SQL queries.
- [json5](knowledge/json5/index.md): Use for JSON5 config with comments, trailing commas, and relaxed syntax. Triggers on 'JSON5', 'config with comments', 'trailing comma config', 'JSON superset'. Do NOT use when transporting data into strict JSON, YAML, TOML, or database-bound converters.
- [jsx](knowledge/jsx/index.md): Use for JSX component trees, props, lists, keys, and accessible markup. Triggers on 'JSX', 'React', 'JSX component element', 'conditional render', 'map to li', 'keys'. Do NOT use as the primary skill for framework build setup, CSS styling, or general business logic.
- [less](knowledge/less/index.md): Use for Less variables, mixins, guards, nesting, and compilation. Triggers on 'Less', 'LESS', 'mixin', '@import', '.less', 'Less compiler'. Do NOT use when standard CSS or project convention selects another preprocessor or stack.
- [liquid](knowledge/liquid/index.md): Use for Liquid templates, Shopify sections, filters, loops, and rendering. Triggers on 'Liquid', 'Shopify', 'filter', 'section', 'render', 'template drop'. Do NOT use as server application logic outside platform constraints or as database migration/configuration work.
- [markdown](knowledge/markdown/index.md): Use for README, ADR, changelog, docs, and GFM content. Triggers on 'Markdown', 'MD', 'README', 'docs', 'documentation', 'changelog', 'ADR'. Do NOT use for executable UI, template logic, API contracts, or structured data exchange.
- [mdx](knowledge/mdx/index.md): Use for Markdown files that contain JSX components. Triggers on 'MDX', 'JSX in Markdown', 'content components', 'MDX loader', 'MDXProvider', 'content site'. Do NOT use when plain Markdown is sufficient, for application runtime behavior, or for Handlebars/EJS-style templating.
- [mustache](knowledge/mustache/index.md): Use for logic-less Mustache templates, partials, and cross-runtime rendering. Triggers on 'Mustache', 'logic-less template', 'partial', 'tag', 'render'. Do NOT use when templates require complex logic, interactive applications, or framework component workflows.
- [protocol-buffers](knowledge/protocol-buffers/index.md): Use for protobuf schemas, messages, field numbering, and compatibility. Triggers on 'Protocol Buffers', 'Protobuf', '.proto', 'protobufjs', 'message'. Do NOT use for human-readable APIs where transparency is more important than binary contracts.
- [pug](knowledge/pug/index.md): Use for Pug server-rendered HTML templates, mixins, includes, and output. Triggers on 'Pug', 'Jade', 'template engine', 'pug filter', 'mixin'. Do NOT use when direct HTML is clearer, when client templating is required, or when framework components are established.
- [sass-scss](knowledge/sass-scss/index.md): Use for Sass/SCSS variables, mixins, partials, nesting, and compilation. Triggers on 'Sass', 'SCSS', 'mixin', '@use', '@forward', 'preprocessor', '.scss'. Do NOT use when modern plain CSS already solves it, or for markup behavior and framework runtime configuration.
- [sql](knowledge/sql/index.md): Use for relational query design, schema, parameterization, and read-only safety. Triggers on 'SQL', 'query', 'SELECT', 'JOIN', 'index', 'relational schema'. Do NOT use to perform broad runtime SQL writes, migrations, direct database access, or unreviewed schema changes.
- [stylus](knowledge/stylus/index.md): Use for Stylus mixins, variables, and flexible CSS compilation. Triggers on 'Stylus', '.styl', 'styl', 'composable mixin', 'Stylus compiler'. Do NOT use for greenfield styling where maintainability, hiring, support, and toolchain maturity matter most.
- [summarize-component](knowledge/summarize-component/index.md): Use when the user asks for a written note, handoff note, rundown, TL;DR, or current-status summary about ONE frontend component, bug, or accessibility issue. Triggers on "handoff note", "rundown", "TL;DR this thread", "what's the status", "where does this stand", "summarize this component", and "give me a note on this before I hand it off", even when the user never says "summarize". A request for a written NOTE or SUMMARY belongs here even when it mentions escalating, handing off, or a deadline. Do NOT use for packaging an unresolved issue for another engineer to act on (that is escalate-review), for drafting customer-facing replies, for triaging a batch of items, or for aggregate metrics.
- [svelte-component-syntax](knowledge/svelte-component-syntax/index.md): Use for Svelte markup, reactivity, each blocks, props, slots, and stores. Triggers on 'Svelte', 'reactive component', '$:', 'each', 'slot', 'Svelte component'. Do NOT use as the primary framework runtime, state architecture, or deployment skill.
- [toml](knowledge/toml/index.md): Use for TOML config, tables, arrays, and tool manifests. Triggers on 'TOML', '.toml', 'Cargo.toml', 'pyproject.toml', 'TOML config'. Do NOT use when rich hierarchical documents are clearer in JSON or YAML, or for dynamic logic.
- [tsx](knowledge/tsx/index.md): Use for TypeScript component syntax and typed props, events, and refs. Triggers on 'TSX', 'typed props', 'React TypeScript', 'generic component', 'component types'. Do NOT use as a substitute for runtime validation, accessibility review, or project configuration.
- [typescript](knowledge/typescript/index.md): Use for TypeScript types, strict contracts, APIs, tsconfig, and migrations. Triggers on 'TypeScript', 'TS', 'interface', 'generic', 'type error', 'strict mode', 'tsx types'. Do NOT use as a validator of runtime data, a framework template syntax skill, or a substitute for tests.
- [vue-template-syntax](knowledge/vue-template-syntax/index.md): Use for Vue directives, bindings, slots, events, and SFC templates. Triggers on 'Vue template', 'v-if', 'v-for', 'v-model', 'slot', 'directive', 'Vue SFC'. Do NOT use as a replacement for Composition API architecture, global state design, or general DOM APIs.
- [webassembly](knowledge/webassembly/index.md): Use for Wasm module design, JS/Wasm boundaries, performance optimization, and native ports. Triggers on 'WebAssembly', 'Wasm', 'wasm-bindgen', 'Emscripten', 'binary module'. Do NOT use for ordinary DOM UI logic or optimization work that lacks measured performance targets.
- [yaml](knowledge/yaml/index.md): Use for YAML config, manifests, CI files, anchors, and safe parsing. Triggers on 'YAML', '.yml', 'YAML config', 'manifest', 'pipeline', 'front matter'. Do NOT use for arbitrary code execution, executable logic, or transport without schema and parser validation.
